content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user viewing the task report","i_want":"to download the filtered and sorted report tasks as an Excel file","so_that":"I can use the report data outside the application","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lets the user download its data to an Excel file. generated.","business_value":"Users can keep a copy of their filtered and sorted task report and work with it outside the application.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page is open and at least one task is shown in the report table","when":"The user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"An Excel file is downloaded that contains exactly the tasks shown in the report table"},{"given":"The report has Status = Open, Priority = High and a sort by Due Date ascending applied","when":"The user exports the report to Excel","then":"The file contains only tasks with Status Open and Priority High, in Due Date ascending order, and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report is filtered so that no tasks match","when":"The user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"No file is downloaded and the page shows a message informing the user that there is no data to export (exact wording is an open question)"},{"given":"An Excel file has been exported from the report","when":"The file is opened","then":"The first row contains a column header for every exported field and every date cell uses the same date format"},{"given":"A file is exported at a given time","when":"The browser saves the file","then":"The filename contains the timestamp of the moment the export was generated"},{"given":"The Backend export request fails","when":"The user clicks the
